title: Kissed Yeasty Dutch Narutomaki Noodles
description: A yeasty, aerated weeknight Dutch dish featuring narutomaki and a mother sauce base, this recipe is kosher friendly and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the milk to the bowl, stirring with a wooden spoon until a smooth batter forms.
Add the sliced narutomaki to the batter and stir gently to combine.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add the chopped onion.
Cook the onion until it is translucent and starting to caramelize, then add the batter to the skillet.
Cook the noodles for 5 minutes on the first side, then flip and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season the noodles with salt, pepper, and nutmeg to taste.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional sliced narutomaki if desired.
